optionsScreenshotIdleHelp: Lite screenshots are off by default. Set a positive interval only when screenshots are allowed. Full mode uses it for browser-side screenshot cadence.
optionsBodyCaptureHelp: Lite never captures page-side response bodies. This caps the browser-side body capture used by Full mode; profiles can override it.
optionsFreezeHelp: The recording goes on and keeps every event either way. Markers are always flagged; network and long-task triggers stay off.
optionsContentInjectionHint: In both modes nothing is recorded before you press Start. Applies to pages loaded after saving; open tabs keep their state until reloaded.
optionsContentInjectionAlwaysDescription: A small script loads in every page and frame from the first byte and waits. Pages a recorded tab loads later (reload, navigation) have it before their own code runs, and password fields the page revealed before Start are already known. Idle cost per page load: one message to the extension and that password watcher.
optionsContentInjectionOnStartDescriptio: Nothing runs in pages you are not recording. The script is injected when you press Start; pages the recorded tab loads later get it right after they commit, which can be after their first scripts ran. Password fields the page revealed before Start are not known as passwords, so a profile that records input values can record them.
optionsBlockedSelectorsHint: Elements whose content is never recorded.
optionsBlockedSelectorsHelp: CSS selectors matched against the page. Matching elements are masked in DOM snapshots, screenshots and input values. Each entry is checked with querySelector.
optionsBodySensitivePatternsHint: Values after these keys are masked in bodies.
optionsBodySensitivePatternsHelp: Matched in JSON, form-encoded and query-like bodies; the value after a matching key is replaced, the key stays readable.
optionsHashSensitiveValuesHint: Keeps equal values comparable without storing them.
optionsActionWindowHint: Requests this soon after a click belong to it.
optionsActionWindowHelp: Network requests that start within this window after a user action are linked to it, so the Player can show what a click caused.
optionsDomFlushHint: How often DOM changes are batched.
optionsSnapshotIntervalHint: Full snapshots for seeking in the Player.
optionsBodyCaptureHint: Largest response body kept in Full mode.
optionsFreezeOnErrorHint: Shows ERR on the toolbar icon and an incident line in the popup.
optionsStartReloadOffer: Offer to reload the page when recording starts
optionsStartReloadOfferHint: Start asks whether to reload the page first, to record its load. When off, recording starts without a reload.
optionsLcpWarnHint: Largest Contentful Paint slower than this.
optionsRequestWarnHint: Requests slower than this count as slow.
optionsAutoFreezeHint: Shows ERR on the toolbar icon and an incident line in the popup.
optionsRecentWindowHint: How much recent history an export keeps.
optionsRecentWindowHelp: Events older than this window before the export are left out of the archive.
optionsPlayerUrlHint: Your organization's Player. “Export and open in Player” on the Sessions page opens it after the export; leave empty to hide that action. Only the page is opened: the archive stays on this computer.
optionsErrorPlayerUrl: Enter an https:// address (http:// only for localhost or 127.0.0.1).
